verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੮ : ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੇ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾ ਦਿੱਤਾ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 18 : satiguroo ne alakh lakhaa dhi'taa

en.bdb: The true Guru has shown the imperceptible

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: paarabraham pooran braham nira(n)kaar aakaar banaiaa|

en.bdb: The transecental Brahm is the perfect Brahm and that very formless (Lord) has created all the forms of universe.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਆਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: abigat gat aagaadh bodh gur moorat hoi alakh lakhaiaa|

en.bdb: He is ummanifest, unfathomable and imperceptible for intellect, but Guru, the icon of beauty, has made me behold the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚਖੰਡ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਹੋਇ ਅਛਲ ਛਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat sachakha(n)dd vich bhagat vachhal hoi achhal chhalaiaa|

en.bdb: In holy congregation, the abode of the truth, He emerges as tender towards devotees and deludes even those who never get deluded.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਇਕ ਵਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: chaar varan ik varan hui aadh purakh aadhes karaiaa|

en.bdb: The Guru alone unites all the four varnas to make them one and further makes them bow before the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਨ ਮੂਲੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਦਰਸਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dhiaan mool dharasan guroo chhia dharasan dharasan vich aaiaa|

en.bdb: At the base of all ascetic disciplines is the philosophy of the Guru in which all the six philosophies  (of Indian tradition) get subsumed.
He himself is everything but never makes Himself noticed by anyone.
